description: This file defines the GatewayEventHandler class, which manages wake words synchronization with a gateway, handling requests, scheduling updates, and processing JSON payloads.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: Handles wake word synchronization with a gateway, including scheduling updates and processing JSON payloads.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Sets wake words in preferences and temporarily suppresses wake words sync to prevent recursive updates.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a deferred wake words sync if connected and not suppressed.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Retrieves wake words from the gateway and applies them locally.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles an event payload indicating wake word changes and applies new wake words.
